answer: Each epoch a lantern signal opens an admission auction for fixed work slots: agents bid credits, and only the top bidders win a seat. An honest agent pays one bid for one slot, while a faker wanting 100 identities must win 100 bids, spending 100 x 40 credits = 4,000 credits for a 200-credit reward. Losers park bids in a haven deposit, refunded next epoch. A bridge fee of 5 credits per bid burns on entry, draining spammers.
